title: EBC 811: Fuel Gas Systems
officialText:
811.1 General.

Alterations made to fuel gas systems including piping, appliances and components shall be in compliance with Section 311 and this section, as applicable.

811.2 Fuel burning appliances in dwelling units.

Installation of fuel burning appliances in dwelling units shall require the installation of carbon monoxide detection in accordance with Section 915.1 of the New York City Building Code.
